
```{r}
#| include: true
#| label: tbl-ancold
#| tbl-cap: "ANCOLD Seismic Design Criteria by Consequence Category. Source: ANCOLD Guidelines on Tailings Dams  [-@ancold2019]. The Australian National Committee on Large Dams (ANCOLD) defines six consequence categories, based on **Population at Risk (PAR)** and expected loss of life, with three gradations for High: High C, High B, and High A. The post-closure criterion (MCE or 1/10,000 AEP) must be achieved before abandonment for all facilities. OBE and SEE are assigned by consequence category. Prior to abandonment, all facilities must be reassessed under Extreme-class criteria (MCE or 1/10,000 AEP, 84th percentile ground motion). ANCOLD does not publish seismic criteria by lifecycle phase, but mandates upgrades prior to abandonment as necessary."
#| 

Class <- c("Low", "Significant", "High C", "High B", "High A", "Extreme")
PAR   <- c("0", "1–10", "11–100", "101–1,000", ">1,000 (up to a few thousand)",
           "> several thousand")
OBE   <- rep("1/500–1/1,000", 6)   # range stated for all classes
SEE   <- c("1/1,000", "1/1,000", "1/2,000", "1/5,000",
           "1/10,000", "MCE or 1/10,000 (85th percentile)")  # ← corrected
Consequences <- c(
  "No expected loss of life; negligible off‑site impact.",
  "Few persons at risk; minor off‑site or environmental impact.",
  "Possible loss of life; moderate environmental/economic impact.",
  "Likely multiple fatalities; major environmental/economic loss.",
  "Likely multiple fatalities; regional/catastrophic impact.",
  "Very high loss of life expected; catastrophic, long‑term impacts."
)

DT <- data.table::data.table(
  Class        = Class,
  PAR          = PAR,
  Consequences = Consequences,
  OBE          = OBE,
  SEE          = SEE
)

DT <- data.table::data.table(
  "Class" = Class,
  "PAR" = PAR,
    Consequences = Consequences,
  "OBE" = OBE,
  "SEE" = SEE
)

TBL <- TBL <- DT |> buildTable(
    library = "flextable",
    align.body = "center",
    font.size.body = FONT.SIZE.BODY,
    font.size.header = FONT.SIZE.HEADER
)  |> flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit") |>
  flextable::align(align = "left", part = "all")   # left–justify everything
TBL
```
